audit.corrected: Both layers set to Singed / Singed / Singed / Aurora / Aurora / Skill / Singed as one atomic group, ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is built on untargetability and wall-walking, neither of which Riot's text gives Aurora, and the whole entry tracks Fling (10s) instead of Mega Adhesive (17s).
audit.why: Between Worlds leaps, shockwaves, slows, and lets her teleport from one side of the zone to the other. No untargetability, no terrain traversal in the description. Fling on 10s is back almost every trade; Mega Adhesive on 17s is the long cooldown and the one that actually decides the fight.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike restated around the rift teleport breaking his chase, and Mega Adhesive's 17s named as the real tracked cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: MEGA ADHESIVE GROUNDS. The entry tells you to 'hold W ready to leap out the instant he flings you' — the exact play that does not work, because he flings you into the goo and grounding locks Across the Veil and Between Worlds both. It also invents an Aurora root three times and gives her untargetability twice.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/singed.json flags Mega Adhesive grounding, slow, zone, projectile. champ-data/_kits/aurora.json has no root and no untargetability anywhere; Twofold Hex curses and drags, The Weirding slows. A reader following the current advice holds W for an escape that is disabled at the moment they need it.
audit.corrected: Grounding written in as the reason to leap BEFORE the goo lands, not after; the root removed; untargetability replaced with the two-way rift teleport.

notes:
Two fabrications in this entry, both load-bearing.

1. AURORA HAS NO ROOT. 'one Aurora root will never hold him', 'one missed root and he simply Insanity-Potions away', 'shrug off your single-target root'. Twofold Hex curses and drags; The Weirding slows. Same class of error as the tahmkench__aurora finding, which found five root strings in that entry — this looks systemic across the Aurora content file and deserves a repo-wide grep for 'root' in champ-data/content/aurora.js.

2. AURORA HAS NO UNTARGETABILITY, and Between Worlds does not walk through walls. spikes[2], mid, late and whys[4] all claim one or both. Riot's text: she leaps, releases a shockwave, and creates an area she can teleport across. Across the Veil grants invisibility. That is the whole list.

THE ACTUAL MATCHUP-DECIDING FACT, absent everywhere: Mega Adhesive GROUNDS (kit flag). The entry's headline advice — hold W and leap out after he flings you — is precisely the play that fails, because the flip puts you in the goo and grounding disables both her dashes. This is the single most valuable correction in the matchup.

Also: the entry tracks Fling. Fling is 10s at rank 1, shorter than Aurora's own W. It is not a window. Mega Adhesive at 17s is. full.focus.text is 'Singed Fling' with letters ['E']; I would move it to Mega Adhesive / ['W'] but did not propose it, since focus.text at 12 characters is below the applier's 25-character skip threshold and I could not confirm focus.letters accepts an edit alongside it.

Deliberately not asserted: whether Between Worlds can be cast to cross terrain. Riot's description says nothing about it and aurora.json needsResearch is empty.
